posts.title: Two spheres spinning
posts.description: The third planet is hurtling around its star at about 107,000kph, circling once per year, as, of course, we say. But that star is travelling around the galaxy at approximately 750,000kph (Kluge 2008), with a ‘galactic year’ taking approximately 230 million years. It may not seem like the sums quite add up. posts.title: Kristeva on Colette on looking at things
posts.description: Kristeva, having discussed Colette saying she is (faux) naive in her appreciation of art, quotes a marvellous passage that I feel suggests a credo for looking at anything. Not just with your eyes, as if a camera, but more… and at the end the poppy is described in terms that make me think she partakes.
